voice.summary: Clear, confident, and warm. Lumen speaks plainly and never hides behind jargon.

principles.title: Plain over clever
principles.description: Say the useful thing directly. Wit is welcome only when it adds clarity.

principles.title: Confident, not loud
principles.description: State things once, with conviction. No exclamation pile-ups.

principles.title: Warm and human
principles.description: Write to a person, not a persona. Contractions are good.

dos: Lead with the benefit to the reader
donts: Don't stack three adjectives where one works
Never bury the point under preamble
